name: lucky
description: Simulated-credit HTML5 slot prototype and deterministic mathematics workspace

scripts.dev: npm run math:build && npm run dev -w @lucky/game
scripts.build: npm run math:build && npm run build -w @lucky/game
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --force packages/shared-types packages/math-engine --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p packages/math-engine/tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p apps/game --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p apps/game/tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p scripts --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run math:validate && npm test && npm run build
